purpose: Give Codex an exact, installable-service-grade contract for the single authoritative Inventory execution path. Facts only; no production writes were performed while collecting them.

authority.why_single: stage_inventory is the only stage that performs discovery. Other stages (morning/pre-send/outreach/post-send/end-of-day/status) never fetch provider pages, so Inventory cannot be split or duplicated without creating a second collector.
authority.dry_run_default: argparse defines --dry-run with default=True; --live is the only switch that performs work. A service must pass --live explicitly.

scheduler_of_record.layer: WorkBuddy automation (external scheduler, not Windows Task Scheduler)
scheduler_of_record.name: RoktRazo BD Inventory - 4x/day (6h interval) Asia/Shanghai
scheduler_of_record.effective_interval: 6h + previous run duration (anchored, not a fixed wall-clock grid)
scheduler_of_record.do_not_create: a second Inventory scheduler; the new service must either replace this scheduler or be driven by it, never run alongside it

api.acquire: acquire_run_lock(name: str = None, holder: str = 'daily_operator', stale_after_seconds: int = 7200) -> bool
api.release: release_run_lock(name: str = None, holder: str | None = None) -> bool

key_layout.value_semantics: holder string while held; literal 'released' after a clean release

call_site.release: bd_orchestrator.py:549 -> release_run_lock(f'inventory:{business_date}', run_id) in a finally block
call_site.failure_branch: on lock conflict the run is finished as status=stopped, stop_reason=lock_conflict, and stage_inventory returns False

run_lock.atomicity: BEGIN IMMEDIATE on the SQLite connection, then SELECT existing value, compute staleness, then upsert both keys, then commit

staleness.rule: a held lock older than 7200s based on _acquired_at is treated as stale and taken over; the takeover is logged
staleness.unparseable_timestamp_behaviour: treated as NOT stale (fail closed, the lock is respected)

run_lock.release_ownership: release only updates the row when value equals the caller's holder string, so one run can never release another run's lock
run_lock.cross_layer_agreement: deploy-channel channel_config.lock declares the identical key_prefix 'run_lock:daily_outreach:inventory:' and stale_after_seconds 7200, so a deploy apply and an Inventory run mutually exclude on the same key

backend.resolved_via: bd_db.DB_PATH (never hardcode; there is a 0-byte decoy bd_leads.db at the repo root that must not be used)
backend.schema_version_note: PRAGMA user_version is 0, so there is no numeric schema generation to gate on. Treat the 27-table set as the contract and verify presence, not a version integer.
backend.wal_implication: wal mode means a service and an interactive operator can read concurrently, but only one writer should act at a time; the run lock is that serializer. A service must also make sure data/bd_leads.db-wal and -shm are on the same volume and writable by the service account.
tables_the_run_touches: job_runs (run_id, status, stop_reason, actual, gap, started_at/finished_at in UTC)
leads (store_name, city, official_website; no website column exists)
provider_request_audit (per-page request_count; page truth, not page count rows)
do_not: do not override the cursor in system_config
do not run against any other .db file
do not switch to TRUNCATE/DELETE journal mode

required_interpreter.why: This is the only interpreter on the host that carries the discovery dependency set.

interpreter_that_must_not_be_used.installed_dependencies: NONE of the required packages are present
interpreter_that_must_not_be_used.consequence: An Inventory run started with the managed interpreter fails at import time or produces a false zero SAFE pool (no dnspython means MX checks silently degrade). All existing RoktRazo-BD-* scheduled tasks point at this interpreter; that is safe only for DB-only stages such as post-send, and is a trap for Inventory.

playwright_browsers.risk: Playwright resolves browsers under the *current user's* LOCALAPPDATA. A service running as LocalSystem resolves to C:\Windows\system32\config\systemprofile\AppData\Local\ms-playwright and finds nothing, so Maps scraping dies immediately.
playwright_browsers.mandatory_fix_for_a_service: Set PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=C:\Users\15690\AppData\Local\ms-playwright in the service environment, or run the service under the 15690 account.

env_loader.semantics: os.environ.setdefault - real process environment wins, .env is only a fallback
env_loader.implication: A service must either inherit a correct environment or rely on .env. Setting an empty or wrong value in the service environment silently overrides .env.
env_loader.no_dotenv: python-dotenv is not installed on either interpreter; do not add 'from dotenv import load_dotenv' to service code

env_file.known_stale_value_not_to_fix_silently: BD_MX_HTTPS_PROXY still points at http://127.0.0.1:3213 (closed). MX currently relies on the dnspython direct-DNS fallback. Changing it is an operator decision, not a service-install step.

throughput_knobs.safe_inventory_target: derived from inventory_target_for_date(business_date): weekday 50, weekend 60; not an env knob

steps: 3. acquire_run_lock(f'inventory:{business_date}', run_id); on failure -> stop_reason=lock_conflict, return False
4. _resolve_active_discovery_state() reads the state cursor from system_config; a state error stops the run before any fetch
5. count SAFE / BROAD / planned FSP and log them (this is the pre-run waterline)

8. provider status gate: if status not in {running, paused_by_runtime_limit, query_completed, places_matrix_completed_web_pending} OR provider_errors -> stop with stop_reason=discovery_provider_error:<status>
12. complete_active_city_if_exhausted (a city may go terminal inside this run)
13. recount SAFE / BROAD, compute gap = max(0, target - safe)
14. finish_job_run(run_id, 'completed' if gap==0 else 'partial', actual=safe, gap=gap, stop_reason='target_met' | 'safe_inventory_gap')
important_semantics: Meeting the SAFE target is an OUTCOME, never permission to skip discovery. DISCOVERY_PATH_EXECUTED is printed unconditionally as true on the live path.
status=partial with stop_reason=safe_inventory_gap and zero SAFE gain is a NORMAL run, not a failure.
A provider failure must not be recorded as 'no email found'; it is a run-level stopped status.
The cursor must never be overridden by the service.

observability_contract.run_record: job_runs rows keyed by run_id; timestamps are UTC and must be shifted +08 to compare with operator logs
observability_contract.provider_page_truth: sum of provider_request_audit.request_count within the run window; counting audit rows undercounts pages
observability_contract.safe_authority: _count_safe_ready_pool(conn) is the only authoritative SAFE number; it is non-deterministic by +/-1 across reads and takes 300-350s per call
observability_contract.broad_ready: _count_broad_ready_pool() is stable and is not the send-gate authority

production_deployer.gates: 14 read-only gates evaluated live before any byte is replaced
production_deployer.lock_behaviour: takes the same official Inventory run-lock key with holder=deploy:<op_id>, never steals a live lock
production_deployer.safety_properties: byte-level backup with fsync and re-read SHA, same-volume temp file, os.replace atomic swap, post-write SHA verification, automatic rollback on failure
production_deployer.state_now: bridge NOT_RUNNING; the deployer is unavailable until the supervisor is started

publisher_layers.do_not_confuse: The handoff publisher ships evidence. The deployer ships production code. A new Inventory service must never gain write access to the deployer channel beyond what Codex already has.

must: run the required interpreter (system Python 3.13.0), never the managed one
cd into the project working directory before running
serialize on run_lock:daily_outreach:inventory:<business_date> via bd_db, never invent a second lock
set PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH so headless chromium is findable
have read/write access to data/bd_leads.db plus its -wal and -shm siblings
probe 127.0.0.1:7877 before a run and fail closed if absent
never override the cursor, never create a second scheduler, never touch SMTP or send paths
must_not: write send_log, suppression, bounce_log or send_authorizations
modify .env, proxy settings, templates or the DB schema
rotate the run lock manually on behalf of another holder
